title: Trading volume on prediction markets has soared in recent months
summary_en: Prediction market trading volume has risen from under $5 billion monthly in mid 2025 to nearly $24 billion in April 2026, with sports dominating.

title: 10 facts about Americans and marijuana
summary_en: Nearly nine-in-ten U.S. adults say marijuana should be legal either for medical or recreational use. Just 11% say the drug should not be legal at all.
